+from rich.text import Text
+from rich.console import Console
+from rich.style import Style
+
+def test_expand_tabs_style():
+    console = Console(force_terminal=True)
+    
+    # Base style: white on black
+    # Text with a tab that has a red style
+    text = Text("Hello\tWorld", style="white")
+    text.stylize(Style.parse("red"), start=0, end=6)
+    
+    # Before expansion
+    # "Hello\t" is red, "World" is white
+    
+    text.expand_tabs(tab_size=8)
+    
+    # After expansion:
+    # "Hello   " (tab expanded to 3 spaces) should be red
+    # "World" should be white
+    
+    # We can verify this by checking the spans
+    # Original length: 11 (Hello\tWorld)
+    # Expanded length: 13 (Hello   World)
+    
+    print(f"Expanded text: {text.plain}")
+    print(f"Spans: {text._spans}")
+    
+    # The span for "Hello   " should be from 0 to 8 and be red.
+    # Wait, "Hello" is 5 chars, tab expands to 3 spaces. Total 8.
+    # So spans should have (0, 8, Style('red'))
+    
+    found_red_span = False
+    for start, end, style in text._spans:
+        if start == 0 and end == 8 and style == Style("red"):
+            found_red_span = True
+            break
+    
+    if found_red_span:
+        print("SUCCESS: Style preserved!")
+    else:
+        print("FAILURE: Style lost!")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_expand_tabs_style()
